narrative_prose: Ryn braces herself against the roaring gusts on the exposed platform, the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea tearing the obsidian waves into jagged, unnatural peaks that defy gravity. The scent of sharp ozone and copper dust bites her nose, while the metallic tang of static electricity coats her tongue. A thunderous, crackling hum vibrates through the metal grate beneath her boots, rattling her teeth as the icy wind stings her cheeks. She tightens her grip on the heavily insulated thermomagnetic calibration rod and shoves the physical baton forcefully into Silas's waiting hands, demanding he anchor the array before the shear destabilizes the colony's fragile metabolic balance.

audits.corrective_authors_note: Ryn's stress levels are spiking too high; must recenter on her Ruler archetype and thermodynamic control instead of panic.

horizon_goals.immediate_session_goal: audit drift in the ferrofluid sea

active_location.macro_silhouette: An exposed observation platform jutting out over the vast, churning black expanse of the ferrofluid sea.

interactive_features.affordance_description: Can be activated to repel the encroaching ferrofluid waves.
Can be polarized to pull floating metallic wreckage for cover.
Can be tapped to drain raw magnetic power into a portable battery.

reactive_toys.motivation_goal: To crash and assimilate anything metallic.
reactive_toys.consistent_method: Rising in gravity-defying spikes and slamming down.
reactive_toys.immediate_complication: It threatens to wash over the platform and sweep away the crew.
reactive_toys.uninterrupted_escalation: The shear will tear the platform from its moorings.
